thread:
monitoring-bot: 🚨 ALERT: realtime-streaming-us-west latency spike detected — 30% client 502s, elevated p95. Threshold breached at 14:11 PST. link: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/incidents/1802102468
tilly: seeing the same in traces, WebSocket pool showing many TIME_WAIT/connection churn. likely backpressure on streaming workers.
elena: rolling restart of streaming-gateway-usw1 in progress (canary now). will monitor error rate.
matt: switching routing policy to prefer uw2 pool for new connections to reduce pressure on us-west. applied at 14:18.
katie: are customers impacted? any major tenants?
tilly: confirmed customer-impacting for a handful of hosted realtime orgs — intermittent truncated streams and 502s. severity: P2 for now but impacting production traffic.
elena: canary restart finished, telemetry shows slight improvement but still elevated p95 for long-maintained connections.
matt: digging into worker-side backlog — queues show slow dequeue rate, likely caused by a recent libuv upgrade combined with a config bump. reverting workers to previous runtime at 14:30 on a small subset.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback started: revert streaming-worker-runtime -> v2.14.1 (from v2.15.0) for 20% pool. job: https://ci.redwood/reverts/12345
tilly: error rate dropped from 32% -> 9% for canary after rollback. continuing rollout.
katie: posting status to customers with short note + link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1802102468 — ETA for full mitigation 30-45m.
elena: full rollback to v2.14.1 completed for all streaming workers at 14:52. most metrics back to normal range.
matt: keeping extra autoscaling buffer active for 1h to absorb any surge.
monitoring-bot: STATUS: degraded -> partial recovery at 14:55. 502s down to ~2.1%, p95 latency within SLO.
tilly: scheduled post-incident runbook review at 16:00 PST. root cause hypothesis: runtime upgrade + config interplay increased event loop stalls under long-lived websocket workloads.
katie: customer comms updated: initial message sent, follow-up planned after RCA.
elena: RCA draft will include mitigation (pin runtime for streaming, add canary gating on queue/dequeue latency, tighter rollout pause conditions).
matt: thumbs up for follow-up actions, will add specific monitoring alert for WS connection churn and worker dequeue latency.
ops-bot: Incident closed to active remediation at 15:10 but on-call will monitor for 2 hours. update: https://internal.postmortems/1802102468
katie: thanks everyone — great coordination. :heart:
